# Docsmith

> A complete Astro documentation template: grouped sidebar, built-in search, reference pages, diagrams, media and a print layout. Copied from GitHub, built for CloudCannon. You write Markdown; the template handles the rest.

## Pages

- [Overview](/): What the template ships with, and where to start.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/introduction/): What it is, who it's for, and what's included.
- [Installation](/installation/): Copy the template, run it locally, add your first page.

## Authoring

- [Writing content](/writing-content/): Frontmatter, callouts, code blocks and tabs, annotations, tables, cross-links.
- [Media & components](/media-and-components/): Collapsible sections, definition lists, diagrams, images, video.

## Customizing

- [Configuration](/configuration/): One data file for the header, the sidebar, search and feedback.
- [Theming](/theming/): Design tokens, the accent, typography, dark mode.
- [Search](/search/): How the index works, what gets indexed, hosted alternatives.
- [Feedback & forms](/feedback-and-forms/): The helpful vote, where it posts, and any other form.

## Reference

- [Config API](/config-api/): Every option, its type, default and effect.
- [Changelog](/changelog/): Releases, by hand, in the same Markdown as everything else.
- [Print & PDF](/print-and-pdf/): What changes on paper, and the page setup.
